exposure: Dichorionic triamniotic (DCT) and Trichorionic triamniotic (TCT) pregnancies reduced to DCDA pregnancies
cohort: The study analyzed data on women with MCDA and DCDA twin pregnancies, conceived either naturally or by ART, from January 2015 to January 2022.
finding: Pregnancy outcomes for MCDA pregnancies conceived by ART are worse than those conceived naturally, and naturally-conceived DCDA pregnancies have better outcomes than DCDA pregnancies conceived by ART or resulting from reduction of DCT/TCT pregnancies.
birth_weight: Neonatal weights were measured as an outcome.
